paragraphs: Docket describes itself as a platform for public health that supplies immunization records to millions of American healthcare consumers. For residents, the pitch is access to personal and family immunization records.

The stated focus is expanding consumer access to state and local immunization registries. Listed capabilities on the site include official immunization forms. Records can also be held as SMART Health Cards and Links.

On data protection, the company says records are encrypted on its servers, on the phone, and everywhere in between. It states that protecting user data is a responsibility it takes seriously. The site footer carries the corporate name Docket Health, Inc.

quote.text: Docket® is a platform for public health that provides immunization records as a service to millions of American healthcare consumers.
